radiology_report:
Erasmus MC
Department of Radiology
Date: 15 January 2025
Exam: mpMRI Prostate (3T)

Clinical indication: Re-evaluation of prostate cancer risk. PSA 12.0 ng/mL. Prior biopsy confirmed Gleason 3+4 (ISUP GG2).

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume measures 42.0 mL.
T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal, hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone of the left apex and mid-gland, measuring approximately 12 mm in maximum diameter. On diffusion-weighted imaging, this region exhibits restricted diffusion with high signal intensity on high b-value images and corresponding low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences show early, marked enhancement of the same lesion. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone (apex/mid), highly suspicious for clinically significant prostate cancer.
Prostate volume: 42.0 mL.
PSA density: 0.28 ng/mL/mL.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. Visser (GP)
previous_notes.text: The patient attended a routine follow-up consultation. PSA was measured at 6.9 ng/mL, representing a rise from the previous value of 4.0 ng/mL in June 2022. Given the increasing trend and prior biopsy findings, a repeat prostate biopsy was scheduled for further histological assessment. The patient was advised to continue monitoring for any new lower urinary tract symptoms.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (June 2024): Histological examination of the prostate core biopsy specimens reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. A cribriform pattern is present within the tumour. Perineural invasion is not observed. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, involving the apex and mid portion of the left side.

Summary: The histological trajectory across the available biopsy timepoints remains stable at ISUP grade group 2, with persistent acinar adenocarcinoma and a documented cribriform pattern.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 2.
